Welcome to Illuminate

Every student can master STEM — with the right guidance

At Illuminate Learning Centre, we believe every student has the potential to master STEM subjects when given the right guidance, structure, and encouragement. The centre is led by two experienced school teachers — Ms. Dsouza and Ms. Raju — who bring 10+ years of experience and are actively teaching in a public school board.

Grades 9 to 12 are critical foundation years. Whether a student is struggling to grasp complex concepts or aiming for a 95%+ average for competitive university admissions, we bridge the gap between confusion and clarity — one concept, one worked example, one win at a time.

Our mission: To illuminate complex academic concepts, build unwavering confidence, and instill critical problem-solving skills that last a lifetime.
  • Diagnostic first session
  • Personal study plan
  • Homework & test support
  • Regular parent updates

How It Works

Start in four simple steps

1

Free consultation

Call, text, or send the form below. We talk about courses, current marks, and goals — no obligation.

2

Assessment & plan

A short diagnostic shows exactly where the gaps are. You get a clear, personal learning plan.

3

Weekly sessions — Brampton or online

Come in person in Brampton, or join live online from home — same teacher, same plan. Each session: teach → guided practice → independent practice.

4

Track & celebrate

Progress is checked against school tests, with updates for parents after key assessments.

Why Families Choose Illuminate

Teaching that actually makes it click

Visual, step-by-step teaching

Tables, diagrams, step-flows and drawn structures — not walls of text. Students see the idea before they memorise it.

Practice in every session

Worked example, guided try, then your turn — with exam-style questions from the very first lesson, not just at test time.

Memory tricks that stick

Picture-based mnemonics and graphic organisers help students recall under pressure — a signature of our lessons.

Support for every learner

Hints, starters and challenge questions are built into every task for everyone — support without labels, challenge without pressure.

Textbook-aligned materials

Worksheets and practice matched to the textbooks and course outlines used in Ontario classrooms.

Parents kept in the loop

Clear updates on progress, upcoming tests, and what to practise at home — no surprises at report-card time.

Questions

Frequently asked questions

Who teaches at Illuminate Learning Centre?

Sessions are taught by our two teachers, Ms. Dsouza and Ms. Raju — experienced school teachers.

Which grades and subjects do you cover?

Grades 9–12: Mathematics (MTH1W through MCV4U & MDM4U), Chemistry (SCH3U, SCH4U), Physics (SPH3U, SPH4U), Biology (SBI3U, SBI4U), and Grade 9/10 Science (SNC1W, SNC2D). Regular, AP, and IB streams are supported.

Where do sessions take place — Brampton or online?

Both. Students come in person in Brampton, or join live online sessions from home, anywhere in Ontario. Online sessions are live and interactive with a shared whiteboard — not recorded videos. Many families choose a hybrid of both.

How does the free consultation work?

Call or text 437-770-6106, or send the registration form below. We'll discuss the student's courses, current marks, and goals, and recommend a plan. There's no obligation to enrol.

What should my child bring to sessions?

Their course textbook or notes, current homework, and any recent tests. We provide worksheets, worked examples, and organisers matched to their course.

How much does tutoring cost?

$40/hour for Grades 9–10 and $50/hour for Grades 11–12 — the same rate for in-person sessions in Brampton and for live online sessions. The first consultation and assessment discussion are free.
